title: Reverse Prefix of Word
summary: Given a string word and a character ch, reverse the segment from the start of word to the first occurrence of ch.
statement: Given a string word and a character ch, reverse the segment from the start of word to the first occurrence of ch. If ch is not found, return the original string unchanged.
constraints: word has 1 through 250 lowercase letters and ch is one lowercase letter.
Reverse the prefix ending at the first occurrence of ch.
If ch does not occur, return word unchanged.
reference_solution:
def reverse_prefix_through_character(word,ch):
    position=word.find(ch)
    if position<0:return word
    return word[:position+1][::-1]+word[position+1:]
known_wrong_solutions:
